subject: Mathematics

show.line: This is a circle. It goes round and round. Your face is round like a circle!

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say it with me. Circle!
Which part of you is round like a circle?
Your eyes are round. How many eyes can you see?
Put the circles in one group. Put the others in the other group.
Find the circle again. It has no corners.

hints: A circle is round, like your face.
A circle has no corners. Run your finger round it.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the circle.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This one! It has pointy corners, so it is a circle.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A circle has no corners. It is round.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. A circle is round, like your face.

parent_line: Can recognise and name a circle.
